question: How many days ago did I go on a whitewater rafting trip in the Oregon mountains?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I'm looking for some recommendations on waterproof cameras for my next outdoor adventure. By the way, I just got back from an amazing whitewater rafting trip in the Oregon mountains with a group of coworkers today, and I wish I had a waterproof camera to capture some of the thrilling moments on the river.

[turn 2] I'm particularly interested in the GoPro Hero8 Black, as I've heard great things about its video quality. Can you tell me more about its stabilization feature? Does it work well in high-shake scenarios like whitewater rafting?

[turn 4] Can I use the Hero8 Black to capture photos during whitewater rafting as well, or is it more geared towards video?

[turn 6] I'm curious about the battery life of the Hero8 Black. How long can I expect the battery to last during a full day of whitewater rafting and camping, considering I'll be using it to capture both video and photos?

[turn 8] I'm planning to bring a portable power bank to keep my devices charged during the camping portion of my trip. Do you think a 10,000mAh power bank would be sufficient to charge my Hero8 Black a few times?

[turn 10] I'm planning to bring a solar charger to keep my power bank charged during the camping portion of my trip. Do you think a 7W solar charger would be sufficient to charge my 10,000mAh power bank in a reasonable amount of time?
